description: This file implements a WKURLSchemeHandler for serving local resources within a WebKit web view, specifically handling custom schemes to serve files from a designated root directory and providing fallback pages if necessary.

classes.name: CanvasSchemeHandler
classes.description: A handler conforming to WKURLSchemeHandler that manages serving local files and pages for a WebKit web view, tailored for use with a custom URL scheme in a sandboxed environment.

methods.name: webView(_:start:)
methods.description: Handles the start of a URL scheme task by generating and providing the appropriate response or error.

methods.name: webView(_:stop:)
methods.description: Handles the stop of a URL scheme task; currently a no-op.

methods.name: response(for:)
methods.description: Generates a CanvasResponse object containing the MIME type and data for the given URL, handling path resolution, security checks, and fallback behavior.

methods.name: resolveFileURL(sessionRoot:requestPath:)
methods.description: Resolves the requested path to a filesystem URL within the session root, considering index files and directory fallback logic.

methods.name: resolveIndex(in:)
methods.description: Returns the URL of an index.html or index.htm file within a directory, if present.

methods.name: isFileURL(_:withinDirectory:)
methods.description: Checks if a file URL resides within a specified directory, enforcing sandbox boundaries.

methods.name: html(_:title:)
methods.description: Creates a CanvasResponse containing a simple HTML page with the provided body and optional title.

methods.name: welcomePage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Generates a welcome page indicating how to create an index.html for serving content.

methods.name: scaffoldPage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Returns a default scaffold page loaded from bundled resources or a fallback welcome page.

methods.name: loadBundledResourceData(relativePath:)
methods.description: Loads resource data bundled within the app based on the relative path.

methods.name: textEncodingName(forMimeType:)
methods.description: Provides the appropriate text encoding name for a given MIME type.
